BEC_ONLY.actuator_source: J2.2 BEC_IN through D9 to J3.2 VSERVO
BEC_ONLY.logic_supply: Board battery and both converter rails required; BEC does not power logic

ONBOARD.actuator_source: 5 V buck through D4 to J3.2 VSERVO
ONBOARD.logic_supply: Board battery and both converter rails required; full-load feed still held

constraints: Never connect a battery directly to J2.2 or J3.2.
BEC_ONLY requires D4 physically absent; diode voltage priority is not an assembly contract.
ONBOARD requires D9 physically absent and isolate any unused ESC BEC positive wire; shared signal ground remains necessary.
No unpowered output-backdrive/hotplug/servo pulse behavior is qualified.
Actual ESC/servo/BEC, harness, signal levels, current, thermal and transient limits must be qualified before use.
